tools.name: base_health
tools.description: base network health: chain id, latest block, gas price and native token USD price. Pay-per-call ($0.002 USDC).

fields.description: Optional comma-separated subset of fields to return

tools.name: base_block
tools.description: Header + summary for a base block by number (or "latest"): hash, timestamp, tx count, gas used, base fee. Pay-per-call ($0.005 USDC).

tools.name: base_balance
tools.description: Native balance and live USD value for any base address. Pay-per-call ($0.005 USDC).

tools.name: base_stables
tools.description: USDC/USDT/DAI balances for a base address in one call. Pay-per-call ($0.01 USDC).

tools.name: base_token
tools.description: Live price, liquidity, 24h volume and DEX pairs for any base ERC-20 token (plus onchain name/symbol/decimals). Pay-per-call ($0.02 USDC).

tools.name: base_tx
tools.description: Status, block, gas and transfer summary for a base transaction hash. Pay-per-call ($0.01 USDC).

tools.name: base_contract
tools.description: Whether a base address is a contract, bytecode size, and ERC-20 metadata if applicable. Pay-per-call ($0.01 USDC).

tools.name: base_gas
tools.description: Current base gas price (gwei + wei) and estimated cost of a 21k native transfer. Pay-per-call ($0.005 USDC).

tools.name: base_trending
tools.description: Trending base DEX pairs by 24h volume (DexScreener boosts). Fresh feed for agents. Pay-per-call ($0.02 USDC).
